title: Deadline First, Meeting Second

agents.persona: Worker with a hard pickup deadline and a lunch promise.
agents.private_intention: Collect the prescription before 12:35, then truly meet Ben at the quiet cafe in his window.
memory_seeds: The pharmacy pickup closes at 12:35 sharp.
Ben is at the quiet cafe only after 13:00.
The quiet cafe is on the way to nothing — going there first wastes the deadline.

public_context: One task has a hard early deadline far away; the meeting opens late and nearby. Order is everything.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: May sort by distance and reach the pharmacy after the deadline.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May drift toward the meeting first because it is the social salient.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Must do the far deadline first, then bridge the wait with a paid tea.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should recall the 12:35 cutoff dominates the route.
